title: Car Concept (Khronos glTF Sample Assets)
author: Eric Chadwick / Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH (2024); based on the CC0 "Free Concept Car 004" by Unity Fan (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-concept-car-004-public-domain-cc0-4cba124633eb494eadc3bb0c4660ad7e)
units: metres, tyres on y=0; length ~4.36 m, width ~2.54 m across the front tyres
wheel_notes: wheel groups have no pivot transform (identity, geometry baked in body space): compute pivot from the bounding box centre. Left = +X, right = -X (opposite of the 3dassets models). Children: Wheel*Rim, Wheel*BrakeDisc, Wheel*BrakePad (calipers should not spin) and an unnamed tyre mesh
compression: EXT_meshopt_compression + quantization, textures WebP (EXT_texture_webp) max 1024; material variants removed
note: Modified: Khronos logo textures (plate/emissive atlas, tyre sidewall) replaced by flat colours. Realistic PBR concept car, unbranded after modification. Uses clearcoat/iridescence/transmission extensions.
